titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 秦庄襄王元年: notes

div.interp: 後七歲: seven years on from the Annals' previous entry, the end of Western Zhou in 256 BC.
Xu Guang: when Zhou was about to perish it had seven Counties in all, Henan, Luoyang, Gucheng, Pingyin, Yanshi, Gong and Goushi.

既: the Suoyin: wholly, as of an eclipse that is total; the line of Zhou was extinguished and there was no one to keep its sacrifices. The Jijie cites Huangfu Mi: Zhou had thirty-seven kings and eight hundred and sixty-seven years in all.
The first year of King Zhuangxiang of Qin, 249 BC.
蒙驚: the three-commentary edition reads 蒙驁, Meng Ao, as the Basic Annals above.
榮陽: the three-commentary edition reads 滎陽, Xingyang.
我: the Table speaks from the standpoint of the state whose column it is, so "our Chenggao and Xingyang" are Han's.
家人: a private person, one without rank or fief.
